description.zh: 从司机消息里整理出每票货现在到哪、多久没更新
description.en: Turn driver chats and locations into clear shipment progress

template.zh: 这些是 <司机群聊、位置和运输记录>。请按 <运单号或你现有的进度表> 整理每票货现在到哪里、最后更新时间和下一步，并根据 <需要重点关注的票> 告诉我还要向司机确认什么。
template.en: Organize <Driver chats, locations, and shipment updates> by <Shipment number or my sheet>, follow <Other requirements>, and show current location, latest update, and questions for the driver.

zh: 司机群聊、位置和运输记录
运单号或你现有的进度表
en: Driver chats, locations, and shipment updates

description.zh: 把运输进度改写成客户能看懂、可以直接发送的消息
description.en: Draft an update, delay explanation, or follow-up message

template.zh: 请根据 <已经确认的运输进度>，给 <要通知的人> 写一段 <进度通知、延误说明或催办消息>，语气自然、可以直接发送，并单独告诉我哪些时间和承诺还不能确定。
template.en: Using <Confirmed shipment progress>, write <A progress update, delay explanation, or follow-up message> for <Customer, driver, or internal team>, and flag timing or promises that are not yet confirmed.

zh: 进度通知、延误说明或催办消息
en: A progress update, delay explanation, or follow-up message

description.zh: 理清异常经过与证据，也可做送达/路况风险识别
description.en: Put events in order and find missing photos or records

template.zh: 这票货出了问题：<异常经过、聊天、照片和说明>。请对照 <运单和运输约定> 把事情经过按时间理清，按照 <公司的处理要求> 找出还缺哪些照片或记录，并写好下一步处理和回复客户的话。
template.en: Using <Problem details, chats, photos, and notes> and <Shipment and transport terms>, follow <Company handling rules>, put events in order, find missing photos or records, and draft next steps and a customer reply.

zh: 异常经过、聊天、照片和说明
en: Problem details, chats, photos, and notes

description.zh: 判断能不能准时到，标出路况/环境风险与建议动作
description.en: Rate on-time risk and road/environment risks with next actions

template.zh: 这些是 <在途进度、司机消息或轨迹说明>。请评估这票的送达风险和路况风险：给出风险等级、触发因素、依据来源和建议动作；承诺时效是 <客户要求的到达时间或窗口>。
template.en: Using <In-transit updates, driver messages, or track notes>, assess on-time and road risks: level, triggers, evidence, and actions. Promised window: <Customer due time or window>.

zh: 在途进度、司机消息或轨迹说明
客户要求的到达时间或窗口
en: In-transit updates, driver messages, or track notes

description.zh: 找出缺签、模糊、缺页或对不上订单的回单
description.en: Find missing, unclear, incomplete, or mismatched receipts

template.zh: 请检查 <签收回单> 和 <对应订单>，按照 <客户或公司的回单要求> 核对运单号、签收时间、签字盖章和异常备注，并找出有问题或需要补的回单。
template.en: Check <Signed receipts> against <Related orders>, follow <Customer or company receipt rules>, verify shipment number, delivery time, signature or stamp, and exception notes, and find receipts that need correction.

zh: 客户或公司的回单要求
